ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels localized in distal patches and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, irregular diffuse high-intensity patch occupying the distal portion of the left lobe; smaller, fragmented high-intensity clusters concentrated on the distal portion of the right lobe; central medial region is solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with well-defined symmetrical inner margins dividing the primary fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; multiple jagged peaks and deep vertical valleys creating a saw-tooth profile isolated from the grey water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral upward-sloping convex curves extending from the medial insertion point to the lateral distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, circular high-contrast white focal points scattered along the distal margins of both lobes and the central right-lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions; prominent long diagonal mark on the left lobe and multiple intersecting parallel and non-parallel rake marks across the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and jagged indentations along the trailing edge profile consistent with physical trauma; high-density linear scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique saw-tooth morphological profile of the trailing edge with prominent deep notches at irregular spatial intervals.
